My own personal math for the KS

 

We need $292,221 to reach 1 million.

We have 27 days

That means as long as we get about $11,000 a day (exact is $10,823) we'll reach the goal.

 

Today was our slowest day to date with $38,935. Even if we only get a 1/3 of that every day until the end of the Kickstarter we're good. And more than likely the last 3 days will be much better than that since people will be finishing up the group buys which probably will be quite large.

posts.name: Ironic
posts.cooked:
Mathematically correct, but I always think it's misleading to look at Kickstarters in terms of average per day, since the total gets SO concentrated in the first three and last two days.  Those five days will generally be something like half of the total amount.

So, don't panic if we drop below 11,000 for a few days, or even below 5,000.  Those last two days should hit at least 200,000 bucks by themselves.  I  am calling it - $1 million is foregone conclusion, and GTG may want to think about stretch goals for 1,250,000 and even 1.5 million.  My usual guideline of "final total is 3x the first three days" is probably optimistic here, but there's really no telling.

posts.name: VikenXetred
posts.cooked:
I think the reason for concern on reacing the $1M stretch goal is actually well placed. While I am confident we will make it, this campaign is very different from others that have this kind of start, and from many campaigns on KS in general.

The fanbase is already there, and most of those that have the game that want to expand have likely already hopped on KS and either pledged or intend to be reminded at the end of the run, the great majority being the former.

Other projects that make 1/2 their final pledge over the first 3 and last 2 days tend to have multiple add-ons (Arcadia Quest has so many...). Additionally, they are either entry level games, or you can get the core game in one of the pledge levels without a huge hit to your wallet. Here we only have The Entire Multiverse, which is a great thing to have, but not everyone can spend $400, so they will probably buy the core elsewhere and, if they like it, pick this up after the KS (unless they try the core soon!)

I fully believe that we can make the 1M, especially if we hit 750k by Monday, but I don't anticipate it soaring much higher than that. I think 1.25M would be pushing it at this rate, but I certainly hope they make as much as 2M for this glorious game :)
